info.title: Formspring REST API
info.description: REST API for managing forms, submissions, webhooks, billing, and AI insights. Pair with the MCP server for agent-driven workflows. The REST API and MCP server use the same token abilities, so the permission model is identical whether code or an agent makes the call. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header; error responses (status 400 and above) carry the typed ApiError envelope with the same request_id. Routes slated for removal announce Deprecation, Sunset and Link rel="sunset" headers without any change to their payload; the change policy is in the API changelog.

tags.name: Action classes
tags.description: In-app / website survey triggers (PRD-C). Code actions fire via the SDK track() call; noCode actions auto-fire from a declarative spec with URL filters. Attach/detach them to surveys.

tags.name: Segments

tags.description: Reference tables (rate cards, zones, stock lists) that form formulas read with lookup() and band(). A customer system creates a table and pushes rows into it: PUT replaces the whole table, POST upserts by a key column. Max 5,000 rows, 20 columns and 1 MB per request.

tags.name: Funnels

tags.name: Bookings

tags.name: Orders

tags.name: Polls
